result.title: I$^2$-Med: Interpretable Medical Inference through Visual-Guided Dynamic Logits Calibration
result.summary: Medical vision language models have demonstrated strong potential for medical image understanding and reasoning. However, their interpretability and reliability remain limited because medical vision language tasks require precise visual grounding and clinically coherent explanations. This is particularly challenging due to complex imaging patterns and scarce expert annotations. These challenges reduce the effectiveness of conventional reasoning methods and lead to visual hallucination, defined as the generation of text that is not grounded in the given visual input, which further limits their applicability in clinical practice. To mitigate these challenges, we propose an interpretable medical inference (I$^2$-Med) framework that enhances visual faithfulness during inference without additional training to improve reasoning and explanation faithfulness in medical vision language models. During text generation, I$^2$-Med uses a visual guidance module to check whether each candidate word is supported by the medical image and consistent with the current reasoning. Based on this guidance, the model's output scores are adjusted to favor visually grounded words, without changing the model parameters. Extensive experiments on the OmniMedVQA benchmark, covering eight medical imaging modalities and five clinical question types, demonstrate that our proposed I$^2$-Med framework generates more clinically meaningful and visually faithful reasoning chains and reduces visual hallucination under standard medical VQA evaluation metrics. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/mtanveer1/l2-med}.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 I$^2$-Med 框架：生成时用视觉引导模块逐词判断候选词是否有医学图像支持并与当前推理一致，据此动态校准输出 logits 以偏向视觉有据的词，在 OmniMedVQA 上提升推理链的临床与视觉忠实度、减少视觉幻觉。
AI.relevance_reason: 属推理期的视觉证据筛选与解码干预，与「答案是否真正使用视觉内容、是否发生视觉旁路」直接相关；其逐候选词视觉校验可作核查线索，但未涉及内部 latent 状态或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 式动态计算。
